name: Change.org petition 'Impuesto sobre las grandes fortunas' (July 2020, addressed to the Asamblea)
detail: Online petition whose promoter is not named on the page; asks for a tax on large fortunes (160 millionaires hold wealth equal to 87% of output). A petition page is not a public statement by a named public figure.

name: FMLN government's 2014 tax package (Treasury minister Carlos Cáceres)
detail: Taxes on unproductive property above $350,000, a 1% minimum tax on company net assets and a financial-transactions tax; real-estate and corporate taxes, not a tax on personal net wealth.

name: Trade unions (May 2022 call for a progressive fiscal reform: property tax, tax on large profits)
detail: Only the UCA press archive's one-line summary of a Diario El Mundo piece of 2 May 2022 was found; a tax on large profits and a predial tax are not a wealth tax, and the article was not opened.

name: Government (Ministerio de Hacienda) on new taxes
detail: Hacienda said in 2025 that the government has no plans to raise existing taxes or create new ones; the Asamblea's Hacienda commission backed tax exemptions for investments of $2,000 million or more.
